encounter.title: Act I Encounter 1 — Square Candidate B (6x6 seed 57)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate B for Act I #1. 6x6 seed 57 (11 arrows: N1 E5 S3 W2). Exact 6x6 arena tile size. 3 free East arrows create False Temptation. Free W is only 1 arrow (#5), which unlocks #6. Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 5 taps (#1 -> #5 -> #6 -> #0 -> #4). Greedily targeting East first allows Grunt W to attack at turn 3 for 2 damage.
